quests.title: Legacy of Orsinium — Mor Khazgur adventure

start.trigger: Visit Mor Khazgur to begin the main adventure. Chief Larak and his son Olur must both be alive.

quests.hook: Explore the expanded mines and an Orcish tomb in a voiced storyline with multiple endings.

requirements.text: Both Chief Larak and Olur must survive until the story starts.

destinations.place: Mor Khazgur's expanded mines and the added Orcish tomb

rewards.label: Orsinium-inspired armor and artifacts
rewards.note: Confirmed expansion-wide content; named items and branch-specific payouts are not yet cataloged.

notes: Use the linked stronghold guides for the other three starting contacts. These titles are Saqrim adventure labels, not invented journal quest names.
quests.spoilers: Multiple endings are documented. Their specific choices and rewards have not been verified here, so this guide does not present one route as the mandatory ending.

quests.title: Legacy of Orsinium — Dushnikh Yal side adventure

start.trigger: Speak with Chief Burguk for this stronghold's added quest.

quests.hook: A separate stronghold story to seek out alongside the Mor Khazgur adventure.
notes: The starting contact is documented; a complete objective chain and specific final payout are not yet indexed.

quests.title: Legacy of Orsinium — Narzulbur side adventure

start.trigger: Speak with Urog or Dushnamub to pick up the added stronghold story.

quests.hook: Another Orc stronghold has its own added story, not just the main adventure's dungeon route.
notes: The guide records the starting contacts without inventing quest stages or a reward list.

quests.title: Legacy of Orsinium — Largashbur follow-up

start.trigger: Finish The Cursed Tribe, then speak with Gularzob.

quests.hook: Return after the original Daedric quest for this expansion's added stronghold story.

quests.title: Undeath — the necromancer pursuit

start.trigger: The author's FAQ says the first quest begins automatically at level 30 or above.

quests.hook: Pursue Antioch and decide whether his search for immortality should end with him.

destinations.place: Scourg Barrow, Dragontail Mountains — no calibrated Saqrim map

notes: For a sewer entrance, check the basements of the Winking Skeever, Bards College or Castle Dour. The map link marks Solitude, not a basement door.
Two upgradeable necromancer lairs and the Broker's unusual supplies are additional content, not a single final payout.

quests.title: Undeath — The Path of Transcendence

start.trigger: Once The Path of Transcendence starts, travel to a Skyrim city and watch for a message.

quests.hook: An optional route to lichdom rather than an automatic reward for defeating a boss.

rewards.note: Requires pursuing and completing the ritual route.

quests.spoilers: Keep the ritual ingredients, read the Ritual Notes and follow their location and component instructions. Collected materials influence the final lich appearance.

quests.title: The Final Cataclysm — main adventure

start.trigger: Reach level 50 and complete The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller. The exact initial contact for this PS5 port is not yet verified.

quests.hook: A demanding dungeon adventure with custom bosses, combat and stealth sections, equipment and magic.

requirements.text: Level 50 and The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller completed.

rewards.label: Bonus adventure access
rewards.note: Finish the main adventure and reach level 60; see the connected guide.

rewards.label: Adventure equipment, weapons and spells
rewards.note: Content categories are confirmed; named pickups and final reward allocations remain unverified.

notes: The creator describes roughly eight hours, follower support and a remotely accessible hub. These are source features, not a timed test of Sam's installation.
No guessed quest-giver or portal pin has been added.

quests.title: The Final Cataclysm — bonus adventure

start.trigger: Complete the main adventure and reach level 60. The precise PS5 handoff is not yet documented.

quests.hook: A reason to return after finishing the main adventure.
notes: Nirn Monolith clues and the creator's color-capsule hunt are also worth checking during exploration; they are not asserted to be the bonus quest's final reward.

quests.title: Rotdyflissa — Rooted In Madness

start.place: Rotdyflissa's tree entrance near Movarth's Lair
start.trigger: Enter Rotdyflissa near Movarth's Lair in Hjaalmarch. Your recorded PS5 description says this starts Rooted In Madness.

quests.hook: Follow the root tunnels of a wandering magical tree and track down the spellsword who tried to reproduce Telvanni magic.

rewards.label: Rotdyflissa's new items
rewards.note: The installed description confirms added items, but not their names, effects or exact pickup points.

notes: Use Movarth's Lair as a nearby landmark, not the dungeon entrance itself. Older indexed text places a previous edition near Whiterun; that is not the route in your recording.
No level requirement is visible in the reviewed installed description.

quests.title: Dagoth Ur — companion and recruitment lead

start.trigger: Public Dagoth Ur listing lead: check the alchemy table in Riverwood's Sleeping Giant Inn. Exact correspondence to your 1.37 GB port remains unconfirmed.

quests.hook: A voiced travelling companion with a custom quest and items described by the public PS listing.

rewards.label: Dagoth's custom quest and items
rewards.note: Public PS listing content; no verified quest trigger, named payout or exact installed-build match yet.

notes: This is a practical place to check, not a verified recruitment result in Sam's save. The guide does not invent his stats, a loyalty threshold or a quest timer.
His addition and load-order position are user-confirmed; the recorded video predates his installation.

loot.name: Lich Form — Undeath ritual unlock
loot.where: Complete the optional ritual route; follow Q052.
loot.note: Not awarded merely for defeating Antioch; use the linked quest guide.

loot.name: Dark Pact — altar blessing
loot.where: Offer blood at an appropriate necromantic altar.
loot.effect: Control up to five reanimated creatures.
loot.note: Optional blessing; an exact altar pin is not yet indexed.

loot.name: Shade of the Revenant — soul-gem ritual
loot.where: Use the associated necromantic altar ritual.
loot.effect: Blacken greater and grand soul gems.
loot.note: A conversion feature, not a new item named Shade of the Revenant.

loot.name: Necromancer's Moon — Broker's book
loot.note: The author changelog confirms the dialogue gift; not a main-quest completion reward.

references.summary: Four Orc strongholds offer adventures, with Mor Khazgur at the center.
A necromancer pursuit with optional lichdom, altar powers and unusual services.
An endgame adventure and a higher-level follow-up, with bosses, equipment and magic.
Rooted In Madness begins in the magical tree near Movarth's Lair.
Companion profile with a public recruitment lead; exact PS5 build identity is still open.
